preRegistered: squad5-core.mjs RULES + data/strategy-library.json SQ5-* (24 Oct 2026, before any run)
standard: PER TRADE (TRY SMALL reads this): each continuous holding = one trade; both halves by entry (before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2%, better than the average liquid stock over the same days, better than the same stock held as long on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5 (63-session blocks) -> TRADABLE SMALL; >= 4.07 -> PROVEN; plus return per year of capital above SPY on the same days in both halves. All gross returns capped at +300% on both sides (AUD-1 capBoth); uncapped = sensitivity. PORTFOLIO: 0.4% per side on all turnover (stress 0.6%), CAGR / max drawdown per half vs SPY, SPUS, HLAL (price) and the equal-weight average liquid stock; beatsSpyBothHalves.
halalNote: No point-in-time halal status exists in the repository; the tests run on the whole liquid market. SQ5-SHARIAH30 uses a point-in-time Shariah PROXY (SIC business screen + debt and cash < 33% of market value), not ZAD.

SQ5-DATA3: Debt under other SEC tags for 17 large companies (and a bogus LongTermDebt = 0 for ORCL): SQ5-SHARIAH30's debt test now uses squad10-core balanceAt (wider tag list, larger of total and parts). Affects SQ5-SHARIAH30 only; SQ5-QUAL20's ROIC proxy still uses the Squad 4 fundamentals.
